title: Freeport Indonesia to wrap up Gresik plant repairs by early September

title: Indonesia Eyes Global Nickel Leadership Amid Smelter Expansion and Price Forecasts
body: APNI’s Meidy Katrin Lengkey highlighted Indonesia’s 414,000‑ton nickel consumption and 54 operating smelters (plus 49 under construction) as the country positions itself to dominate the global battery and stainless‑steel supply chain, while noting a 700‑million‑ton smelter demand and reliance on Philippine imports. She warned of a shift from a three‑year RKAB to a one‑year plan, projected 2026 start, and forecasted nickel‑based product prices at $15,000–$16,000 next year, urging government action to keep costs competitive and avoid investment‑climate disruptions.

title: Indonesia Nickel Mining Sector Faces Rising Costs and Supply Challenges Amid Biodiesel B40 Program Review
body: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources convened a forum to assess the 40% biodiesel (B40) mandate, noting a 3–5% rise in nickel smelter production costs amid a 15,000‑per‑ton drop in nickel prices and added export and tax regulations. Stakeholders called for quarterly evaluations, supply chain guarantees, and potential policy flexibility ahead of a forthcoming B50 shift to avoid burdening the industry.
